services.name: Whale Watch
services.desc: More than just watching whales. Main Deck: Ages 13+ - $79.00 Main Deck: Ages 3 - 12 - $69.00 Upper Deck: Ages 13+ - $89.00 Upper Deck: Ages 3 - 12 - $79.00 Infants Ages 2 and Under - $29.00 3.5 - 4 Hours About Join us as we search for marine wildlife! From Humpbacks, Finbacks, Minkes, and North Atlantic White-Sided Dolphins, to Basking sharks, Ocean Sunfish, Sea Turtles, as well as countless seabirds and more! What to Bring We recommend bringing an extra layer of clothing. Even if it's warm and sunny at the dock the temperature can sometimes drop 10 or 15 degrees when we get Aboard "ODYSSEY" · Approx. 3.5 - 4 hours · Price increase may apply during peak season

services.name: River Nature Cruise
services.desc: Aboard "EXPLORER" · 45 min. nature cruise in the Fore River, see birds & seals · $29 adults, $25 kids

services.name: Seal Watch
services.desc: at Halfway Rock, a seal rookery in Casco Bay. We’ll head out through Portland’s working waterfront aboard "EXPLORER", our open-to-air Carolina Skiff, to look for seals and sea birds, passing forts and lighthouses along the way. A great trip for families! Trip time: Approx. 45-60 minutes | Cost: Aboard "EXPLORER" · 45-60 minute cruise to a seal rookery · $36 for adults, $31 for children

services.name: 4th of July Fireworks Cruise
services.desc: Join us for a harbor cruise through Casco Bay before we watch the fireworks off of East End Beach in Portland. There's no better view of the fireworks in the city than from the water! Cash bar and restrooms available on board. Approximately 2 hours. Starting from $65 per Aboard "ODYSSEY" · Starting from $65 per passenger · Approx. 2 hours

services.name: Private Charter on the Casco Bay "Explorer"
services.desc: Up tp 16 passengers. Join us on Casco Bay for a private happy hour or sunset boat ride. BYOB! $200 for the first 4 passengers, then $44 each additional person beyond Private charter aboard Explorer
